text:
Clara: Quick thread to finalize the partner handoff + scope acceptance flow for design partners. need something <1 page for invites.
Jamal: Can we make it checklist-driven? partners love clear do/don't bullets.
Satoshi: From eng: classify asks as `blocker`, `integration`, `capacity`, `ui`. map each to expected response windows.
Noor: CS feedback: partners expect decisions fast. propose ack within 24-48h and a firm ETA for blockers within 72h.
Priya: Product proposal: Small canonical rules to paste into invite: 1) Blockers (safety/contract) -> we fix during pilot. 2) Integration/API -> evaluate; if <3w include, else backlog unless credits. 3) Capacity -> needs 3-week ops runway. 4) UI/docs -> backlog but we provide workaround.
Clara: Decision: adopt Priya's 4 buckets. SLA: ack within 48h; blocker ETA in 72h. credits only if we commit eng time during pilot window.
Jamal: Ticketing: add labels `dp:blocker`, `dp:integration`, `dp:capacity`, `dp:ui` and a `dp:credits` boolean. also add fields `dp:ack_ts` and `dp:eta_ts`.
Satoshi: Ops note: capacity changes may require reserved nodes or quotas -> minimum 3-week lead + infra signoff. call that out in intake.
Noor: I'll draft partner-facing blurb. short & plain english: "We triage partner requests within 48 hours. Items that block the pilot will receive a target ETA within 72 hours. If work requires infrastructure or capacity changes, additional lead time may be required; we'll tell you up front."
Priya: Add a one-liner about approvals for credits: "Credits for engineering work performed inside the pilot require product + finance approval."
compliance-bot: Reminder: Any ask that modifies data retention, logging, or access control must be flagged to Legal/Compliance before development begins.
Clara: Action items:
- Noor: post partner blurb + 3-bullet checklist in invite template (EOD).
- Jamal: add labels + ticket fields to tracker and share PR (tomorrow).
- Satoshi: capacity checklist and ops runway doc (2 business days).
- Priya: update partner intake form with credits checkbox and approval flow (Friday).
Clara: We'll trial this flow for the next 5 design partners and iterate after. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Noor: will post the blurb now.
Jamal: starting the PR after lunch.
Satoshi: will sync with infra on runway constraints.
Priya: adding approvals matrix to intake.
